text: After the gruesome death of a student at Sta. Lucia Academy, an old Catholic school for girls, the guidance counsellor Pat Consolacion tries to help the students cope and to learn what happened. Most suspect the strict, borderline abusive Mother Alice, but Pat's [clairvoyant gift|rules|only some can see it] leads her to Eri, [a former student who has watched the school for years|threat|the restless dead]. In the confessional, Eri speaks of [bullying by the girls and punishment by the nuns|wrong|cruelty and humiliation], and of [the school bathroom where she hanged herself|images|buildings and public places].
